description: PARITY LOCK (integer-valued floats): identical to recurr-golden but per_cycle_amount_minor, cap_amount_minor and the execution amount_minor are written as integer-valued JSON floats (500.0, 60000.0). JCS collapses 500.0 to 500, so the references are byte-identical to the golden and this is the SAME signed object. Python's json keeps these as floats while Node's JSON.parse yields integers; before the _pos_intish fix Python REJECTED this chain and Node ACCEPTED it -- a verifier divergence on one chain. Both must now verify OK and capped.
